payout_value_note: $100-$600 across 3 independently achievable legs ($300 checking DD + $100 savings deposit + $200 both-at-once)
payout_quote: Receive a $300 bonus when you open a Freestyle Checking account and set up and receive a total of $2,000 or more in direct deposits within the first 90 days of opening. Receive a $100 bonus when you open a Freestyle Savings account and deposit $5,000 within 30 days of opening and maintain a $5,000 minimum daily balance for 60 days. Receive an additional $200 bonus when you open both accounts at the same time and meet all requirements.
steps: Enter your email on the Hancock Whitney New Client Offer page (linked via hancockwhitney.com) to receive the promo code.
Open a new Freestyle Checking account by 2/28/2027 using the promo code, with the email at account opening matching the code-request email ($25 minimum opening deposit).
Within the first 90 days, have $2,000+ in qualifying recurring direct deposits (payroll, pension, Social Security, government/monthly income) post to the checking account - for the $300 leg.

Optionally open a Freestyle Savings account at the same time ($25 minimum deposit), deposit $5,000 within 30 days and maintain a $5,000 minimum daily balance for 60 days - for the $100 leg + the $200 both-at-once bonus.
Keep accounts open with positive balances; bonuses deposit within 135 days of opening.
catches: The full $600 requires opening BOTH Freestyle Checking and Freestyle Savings at the same time and meeting all requirements (savings leg needs $5,000 tied up 60 days).
The emailed promo code is personalized/non-transferable; the email at account opening must match the code-request email.
New Hancock Whitney checking clients 18+ only: new-to-bank, or existing clients with no current checking, no checking closed in past 90 days, and none closed with a negative balance in 3 years.
One consumer checking bonus and one savings bonus per household every 2 calendar years; lifetime maximum of 2 checking and 2 savings bonuses per household.

Qualifying direct deposit = recurring payroll/pension/SS/government income from employer/external agency; excludes own-account transfers, Zelle/PayPal/Cash App, tax refunds, wires, branch/ATM/mail/mobile/online deposits.
$20 closing fee plus bonus clawback if the checking account is closed within 180 days; $20 early closure charge on savings for 180 days (released afterward).
$10/month checking fee (waivable with one client-initiated transaction per cycle) and $5/month savings fee (waivable with $250 balance or one transaction).
TX, LA, MS, AL, FL residents only. Offer expires 2/28/2027; bank may change/discontinue anytime.
Bonuses may be considered interest and reported on IRS Form 1099 (taxable).
biggest_catch: The advertised $600 is a three-leg stack: $300 checking needs $2,000 in direct deposits within 90 days, $100 savings locks $5,000 for 60 days, and the extra $200 only pays if both accounts are opened at the same time - plus the personalized promo code and email-match step means you cannot skip the email capture.
eligibility: New Hancock Whitney checking clients 18+, residents of TX, LA, MS, AL, or FL. New-to-bank or existing clients with no current checking, no checking closed in the past 90 days, none closed with negative balance in 3 years.
timing: Open by 2/28/2027 (157 days from check date). Earned bonuses deposited within 135 days of opening; accounts must be open with positive balances at award.
